import pandas as pd

corporate_actions = pd.read_csv('corporate_actions.csv')

# Filter the quotes for the latest date (2025-10-07)
latest_quotes = quotes[quotes['date'] == '2025-10-07']

current_holdings = {
    "SPY": 0.1975,
    "QQQ": 0.1974,
    "GLD": 0.2248,
    "NVDA": 0.1912,
    "ORLY": 0.1891
}

print("Current Weights:", current_weights)

    return np.convolve(data, np.ones(window)/window, mode='valid')
